user.title: HDL Buspro Gateway
user.description: Auto-detect HDL Buspro gateways on the local network and pick one, or enter the IP and port manually.

manual.title: Enter Gateway Address Manually
manual.description: Enter the HDL Buspro gateway IP address and port.

add_device.title: Add Device
add_device.description: Select the type of device to add.

add_light.title: Add Light
add_light.description: Enter the address and name for the light device.

add_switch.title: Add Switch
add_switch.description: Enter the address and name for the switch device.

add_binary_sensor.title: Add Binary Sensor
add_binary_sensor.description: Enter the address and type for the binary sensor device.

add_sensor.title: Add Sensor
add_sensor.description: Enter the address and type for the sensor device.

add_cover.title: Add Cover (Curtain)
add_cover.description: Enter the address, channel and name for the curtain device.

data.travel_time: Travel time in seconds (for position estimation)
data.name: Name (optional)

add_button.title: Add Button
add_button.description: Add a momentary button (e.g. one IR code of the AC emitter). Channel is the universal switch number.

add_climate.title: Add Climate
add_climate.description: Enter the address and type for the climate device.

add_scene.title: Add Scene
add_scene.description: Enter the target device address and the (area, scene) numbers to trigger.

scan_bus.title: Scan Bus Devices
scan_bus.description: Start scanning the bus for all devices. After scanning, the results will be shown for import.

scan_bus_devices.title: Select Devices to Import
scan_bus_devices.description: Select devices you want to add. For sensors, choose the subtype (temperature or illuminance) per device, then submit.

bus_scan.title: Scanning bus...
bus_scan.description: Sending probe requests to the bus and collecting device responses, please wait.

bus_scan_confirming.title: Confirming devices...
bus_scan_confirming.description: Verifying scanned device data, please wait.

abort.scan_failed: Scan failed, check network connection and retry.
abort.no_devices_found: No devices found, check gateway configuration and bus connection.

error.already_exists: Device {device_key} already exists and cannot be added again.
